acceptance: Configuration, under SECURITY, shows ALBUM SHARING as a two-value select reading OFF on a site that has never saved it. Choosing ON and saving stores it; a fresh load of Configuration still shows ON. With it OFF the cross-site POCKET ALBUM endpoint answers 404 with an album-sharing-not-enabled body; with it ON the same request returns the album payload. The control is not a checkbox, and it is not reachable by a non-administrator account.

The page is not reachable by a non-administrator account.

acceptance: THE VERSION EPOCH, which is the change in this build that can stop a site taking updates at all. On a site holding a skin at a 2.x number, SMACK CENTRAL offers the re-baselined 0.7.x build as NEWER rather than refusing it as older, and installing it leaves the skin working and reporting the new number. A skin whose manifest carries no epoch is compared exactly as before, so nothing that was offered stops being offered. Core's own update check still offers the next core build on a site running the current one. Nothing on the page changes for a reader.
